facts.fact: The NEMISA strategic plan 2017-2022 says e-skills capacity building and rollout, including digital literacy, is currently delivered by six provincial CoLabs at universities, and sets a programme of e-skills training with a target of 100 per cent digital literacy; no count trained is given.
